'''Morgan McKinley''' is an Irish professional services [[recruitment]] consultancy. Founded in 1988, the company has operations in the U.K, Australia, China, [[Hong Kong]], Canada, [[Singapore]], Ireland and Japan.<ref>[http://gulfnews.com/business/sectors/careers/revealed-why-uae-recruiters-trash-your-cv-1.1681812 "Revealed: Why UAE recruiters trash your CV"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304053938/http://gulfnews.com/business/sectors/careers/revealed-why-uae-recruiters-trash-your-cv-1.1681812 |date=2016-03-04 }}. ''Gulf News'', March 1, 2016 By Cleofe Maceda, Senior Web Reporter</ref> It is headquartered in [[Cork (city)|Cork]], [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.irishtimes.com/business/retail-and-services/recruitment-firm-morgan-mckinley-to-create-80-jobs-1.2372571|title=Recruitment firm Morgan McKinley to create 80 jobs|first=Charlie|last=Taylor|website=The Irish Times}}</ref>

==History==
Morgan McKinley was founded in the UK in 1988 by Pat Fitzgerald.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.irishtimes.com/business/retail-and-services/morgan-mckinley-eyes-global-growth-as-it-restructures-management-team-1.3414723|title=Morgan McKinley eyes global growth as it restructures management team|first=Mark|last=Paul|website=The Irish Times}}</ref> In 2008 The Premier Group, a recruitment company founded in Ireland in 1988, acquired the business for €60 million and rebranded all of its Irish and international recruitment operations Morgan McKinley.<ref>[http://www.businessandleadership.com/business/item/25906-morgan-mckinley-to-create-7 "Morgan McKinley to create 75 jobs, Business & Leadership"]. ''Business and Leadership''. {{Dead link|date=October 2016}}</ref>

In 2009 Irish Taoiseach Enda Kenny opened Morgan McKinley’s [[Shanghai]] office.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Barry |first=Aoife |date=2012-03-26 |title=Kenny welcomes €5 million Chinese investment by Morgan McKinley |url=https://www.thejournal.ie/kenny-welcomes-e5-million-chinese-investment-by-morgan-mckinley-396837-Mar2012/ |access-date=2024-07-18 |website=TheJournal.ie |language=en |archive-date=2022-06-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220629074948/https://www.thejournal.ie/kenny-welcomes-e5-million-chinese-investment-by-morgan-mckinley-396837-Mar2012/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Doyle |first=Carmel |date=2012-03-26 |title=Taoiseach opens Morgan McKinley's Shanghai offices - Companies {{!}} siliconrepublic.com - Ireland's Technology News Service |url=https://www.siliconrepublic.com/companies/taoiseach-opens-morgan-mckinleys-shanghai-offices |access-date=2024-07-18 |website=Silicon Republic |language=en}}</ref>

In 2021, Morgan McKinley acquired Cork-based outsourcing firm, Abtra.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.irishtimes.com/business/financial-services/morgan-mckinley-acquires-cork-based-outsourcing-firm-abtran-1.4743963|title=Morgan McKinley acquires Cork-based outsourcing firm Abtran|website=The Irish Times}}</ref>

==Publications==
The company publishes the London Employment Monitor which is used as an indicator of the jobs market in the [[City of London]]. The company also publishes the Irish Employment Monitor which tracks employment trends in the Republic of Ireland.<ref>[http://www.theglobalrecruiter.com/news/morgan-mckinley-report-gives-mixed-messages/7757 "Good Month, Bad Year"]. ''Global Recruiter'', Sep 11, 2016</ref>
